description: NekRS (Cardinal fork), published by neams-th-coe, solves incompressible and low-Mach fluid flow, scalar transport and conjugate fluid-solid heat transfer with spectral elements on high-performance computers. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The reviewed neams-th-coe repository is a fork for use in Cardinal. It requires MPI and compatible accelerator or CPU tooling; upstream and fork versions must be distinguished. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The existing model-cardinal record identifies NekRS as one of its coupled reactor-analysis components.
